ui_bugs.issue: React duplicate-key warnings for every conversation id (21+). Root cause: Sentinel's useEffect re-subscribes IntersectionObserver on every render (onVisible arrow is a new ref each render), and loadConvs appends with no dedup (setConvs(prev => [...prev, ...r.data])). Rapid IO callbacks before convsLoading toggles can re-append the same page. Fix: dedup in setConvs (e.g. by id) and/or stabilise onVisible with useCallback + guard with a loadingRef.
Removed routes render a blank body (React Router warning 'No routes matched location'). Not broken but add a catch-all redirect to /home for cleaner UX.

rca of the issue: Duplicate React keys in Chat conversation list: Gallery.jsx Sentinel re-creates its IntersectionObserver every render (onVisible dep changes identity), so the IO can fire onVisible multiple times rapidly before convsLoading state propagates and hides the sentinel. Each fire calls loadConvs(q, true) which uses offset=convs.length (stale closure value identical across fires) and appends the same page. loadConvs line 80 does `setConvs(prev => [...prev, ...r.data])` with no dedup. Mitigation: (a) wrap onVisible in useCallback with stable deps; (b) add `if (loadingRef.current) return;` guard inside loadConvs; (c) dedup by id when merging.
